overview_description.description: Axiom provides tech-enabled legal, contracts, and compliance solutions for large enterprises. Its solutions combine legal experience, technology, and data analytics to deliver work in a way that dramatically reduces risk, cost, and cycle-time. The firm comprises 2,000-plus lawyers, professionals, process engineers, and technologists who serve over half the Fortune 100 across 15 regions and three centers of excellence globally.

about_short_description.short_description: Axiom provides tech-enabled legal, contracts, and compliance solutions for large enterprises.

product.name: On-Demand Legal Talent
product.description: A talent-matching and engagement service connecting in-house legal teams with vetted lawyers, paralegals, and legal professionals for full-time, part-time, or ad hoc work.

product.name: Secondments
product.description: Flexible full-time or part-time placement of Axiom legal professionals into an organization to cover temporary resource gaps, workload increases, leave, or defined legal initiatives.

product.name: Projects
product.description: Hourly-billed legal project teams led by experienced lawyers for complex, high-volume, or time-sensitive initiatives requiring coordinated delivery and centralized oversight.

product.name: Tech+Talent
product.description: An AI-enabled legal service that combines Axiom legal professionals with artificial intelligence to accelerate document review, contract work, due diligence, privacy assessments, and other legal operations.

product.name: Specialized Advice
product.description: On-demand access to experienced legal professionals for strategic, high-complexity, or practice-specific advice on an ongoing or as-needed basis.

product.name: Recruitment Solutions
product.description: Permanent and interim-to-permanent legal recruiting services that help organizations identify and hire lawyers and legal professionals with law-firm and in-house experience.
